dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: Here for the show? Come on in and take a seat!

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: Have you gone to see Ms. Yun's new opera? Ah, she truly is Liyue Harbor's superstar — there's no arguing that point!

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: It's just that each time I watch her perform, I am always reminded about those things that happened in the past... *sigh*

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Xingyan...

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: Xingyan? What? Who's that?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: She's Yun Jin's friend...

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: Oh, right, yes! I mean, I am getting on years, you know? Starting to forget and all, haha!

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: Ah, but it's getting late, isn't it? My dear Xingyan might be calling it a night soon, in fact. What would you like to ask her?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: She's your adopted daughter...

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: Oh, right, yes! I mean, I am getting on years, you know? Starting to forget and all, haha!

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: Ah, but it's getting late, isn't it? My dear Xingyan might be calling it a night soon, in fact. What would you like to ask her?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: If she'd like to go see a rock 'n' roll concert.

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: ...Hah, so Ms. Yun sent you.

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: Ah, Ms. Yun... Whenever she wants to go out to see a rock concert, she has to find some excuse to prevent those old codgers in the troupe from finding out.

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: Imagine that, eh? A man at my age, going along with various deceptions, exchanging code-words, doing things in secret...

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: ...Actually, it's all rather exciting.

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: That was fantastic! What a blast...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hello.

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: Shh, listen to this! It's a real blast!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hello?

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: I told you to shush! What could you possibly want that can't wait until the story is finished!?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Rex Lapis' death...

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: Away with you! I don't care if the sky is falling, I'll worry about it after the story ends!

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: Wait... Rex Lapis, you say?

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: That's... possibly just as bad as the sky falling!

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: How did you hear about this?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye...

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: Encore, encore!

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: Here for the show? Come on in and take a seat!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sir, might I know your name?

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: "Sir"? No need to be so polite on my account! Just call me Er'ye. Pronounced "Ah yeah!"

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: I'm the boss of this tea house here. Is everything to your liking?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the tea shop...

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: What do you think of the place? Let me tell you something, that stage, these tables and chairs, the private rooms upstairs, the performers, the kitchen staff...

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: I was the one who made it all what it is today. I paid my dues when I was young... Granny Ruoxin and I used to sing together on that stage all the time.

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: Eventually I made a name for myself and saw some success. Enough to buy the place up myself. Now I run it.

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: Granny Ruoxin? Hehehe, oh how times change. Put it this way, forty years ago she was no less of an acting sensation than Yun Jin is today!

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: Sadly, she had her heart stolen by some adventurer in green clothing who never came back for her. Poor thing, she's had no one to rely on her whole life...

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: Maybe things could have been different if I had only told her the way I felt... But I digress. No use in digging up the past.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: Won't you stay? Suit yourself, take care now!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Rex Lapis' death...

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: Away with you! I don't care if the sky is falling, I'll worry about it after the story ends!

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: Wait... Rex Lapis, you say?

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: That's... possibly just as bad as the sky falling!

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: Ugh, out of the way, I'm trying to listen!

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: Huai'an's story is getting to the good part — the Bishui River! It's a classic tale, and this is the most iconic section!

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: This year's Mingxiao Lantern was designed in honor of the protagonist; namely, Skybracer.

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: You should listen too — seriously, if there's one thing you should do this Lantern Rite, this is it!
